prompt: Bold, clean, clear 2D cartoon illustration with crisp continuous outlines, clear silhouettes, flat clean colors and a small number of smooth cel-shaded shapes. Keep the focal action readable at child-facing display size. Draw material details with simple outlined shapes and restrained flat marks. No painterly rendering, gouache, watercolor, brush daubs, patchy paint, visible brushwork, paper or canvas grain, embossed or impasto relief, pebbled surfaces, fuzzy edges or hyper-textured material rendering. Create one professional children's storybook environment atlas: an EXACT THREE-ROW TRIPTYCH on a square canvas, 1254 x 1254 or higher. Each row is a complete seamless horizontal 3:1 panoramic background, with hard row boundaries at precisely one third and two thirds of canvas height. Row 1: a quiet sunny meadow garden clearing, clean flat green grass shapes, warm soil path in foreground, distant bushes, light pale blue sky. Row 2: a quiet daylight river crossing, natural grassy riverbank at left and right, a shallow blue river running vertically through the central third toward foreground, no bridge, no raft. Row 3: a quiet moonlit woodland clearing, muted deep blue twilight sky, natural trees at edges, clear open foreground, gentle moonlight. Cohesive bold clean cartoon rendering, no diagrams, no geometric shape construction, crisp continuous outlines, no characters, no props, no words, no numerals, no borders, no labels. Keep center uncluttered for animated characters placed later. Ground horizon around middle and enough foreground to place objects along lower fifth. Rows are equally tall and completely separate. Purposeful calm background for early years literacy question cards. Full opaque background.
sourcePrompt:
Edit the FIRST reference. Preserve ALL exact objects/scenes, order, colours, positive/negative spaces, material meanings and semantic contrasts. SECOND reference is STYLE ONLY: its bold clean clear 2D cartoon rendering is the target. Do not copy its objects or layout. Simplify the entire first image substantially into large flat solid colour fields, bold continuous dark outlines and at most one or two broad hard-edged cel shadows per object. No wood grain, growth rings, tiny line scratches, hatchwork, fuzzy foliage, paint flecks, granular texture, gradients, shine, glossy highlights, raised veins, embossed modelling, photorealistic material or 3D-like surface rendering. Each material needs only its clear shape, simple appropriate flat colour, and a FEW large drawn marks. Wood: solid warm orange-brown and one broad darker side, no more than two small short accent marks per object. Stone: a few broad flat gray planes. Leaves: flat green silhouettes with one central vein and few large simple branches. Cloth: simple flat cream shape and a broad fold shadow. Shells: broad cream contour segments with very few simple drawn curves. Rope/nest/weave: few large clear interlocking segments, never dense tiny fibers/twigs. Preserve intended rough/smooth teaching distinctions only with visibly jagged edges and a FEW large flat marks versus an unmarked smooth silhouette, never relief/texture. No added props, words, labels, grid, logos, people, religious/national/political symbols or flags. Plain single-colour game-course pennants only where specified.

ONE OPAQUE square PNG with exactly THREE equal horizontal strips, each strip exactly3:1 width:height. Preserve the first reference scenes and row boundaries. TOP DAY: sunny open green meadow/clearing, simple trees framing both sides, low blue mountains, blue sky, white rounded clouds, clear empty central tan path/ground. MIDDLE RIVER: bright blue river viewed from low bank height, green banks and a few simple broad gray rocks on both sides, trees framing sides, open water in center, blue sky. BOTTOM NIGHT: same neutral open woodland clearing at night, navy blue sky, simple round pale moon and a few stars, dark blue-green trees framing sides and broad clear empty foreground. Simplify ALL grass, leaves, bark, rocks and water to large flat shapes like the style reference. No mottling, tiny scattered ground marks, craters, leafy microdetails or wood grain. No characters, buildings, vehicles, tools or text. No transparency, no borders between strips, no frame. Keep every entire strip; no row cropping, blending or vertical overlap. Canvas square2048x2048 or larger if possible.
